value.answer: For the US market, I'd go with the Toyota Sienna. Edmunds has it top at 7.8/10 and KBB calls it their top-rated minivan, and it gets 36 mpg combined. The Honda Odyssey is the other strong one, with U.S. News giving it 9.3/10 and it drives most like a car. Reviewers don't agree on a winner, so it comes down to whether you want the Sienna's fuel economy or the Odyssey's driving feel.
